programs.description: After relocating to a remote village on an island, a man hopes to restore his and his family's life. However, his family starts to witness paranormal incidents in their house.
A girl from a wealthy family falls in love with a poor boy from her college. However, things take a turn when her disapproving mother sends thugs to kill her lover.
Manoharan leads a peaceful life with his family. However, fear engulfs him when he realises that a sketch of a wanted terrorist resembles him.
A wealthy heiress plans to implicate her former boyfriend for her murder by hiring an assassin. Things take a turn when a thief enters the house at the same time.
Vidyalakshmi struggles to lead a normal life with her daughter after the sudden death of her husband. However, her world transforms after meeting Preman, an auto-rickshaw driver.
Kochu, an alcoholic, is a member of the Vadakkan Veettil family who leaves them after a fight. He later comes home for his share when their wealth is being divided.
After being forced to quit his own academy, Vishnu, a choreographer, comes across a group of talented dancers. He decides to take them under his wing and train them to be the best in the business.
Passion and conflict intertwine in the turbulent relationship of a strong-willed couple, forging an intense emotional bond through their shared journey.
Prince, a dog trainer, faces an awkward situation when his pet dog Diana acts in a film alongside his former lover, an actress who shares the same name as the dog.
Nityananda Shenoy, a gangster from Kasaragod, decides to exact revenge on an ex-minister who swindled him right before demonetisation. Meanwhile, Muthuvel and his mother struggle to survive in Kochi.

Daya Shankar, a courageous police officer, befriends Geevarghese, a notorious criminal, and earns his trust. However, things get complicated after the policeman reveals the real reason for his friendship.
Vasoottan, an autorickshaw driver, helps Parvathy and her distressed family to deliver a hundred Jamnapari goats so that she can save her farm from the evil clutches of Sridharan.
En route to Bangalore, a man falls in love with a beautiful girl. But he soon realises that her father was responsible for the death of his sister during a terrorist attack a long time ago.
Mannar Mathai runs a travel agency with his friends, Gopalakrishnan and Balakrishnan. He wants to revive his drama group on its 25th anniversary, but his friends refuse to act again.
Teresa, Rehna and Premila leave their spouses due to marital discord and live independently. Gopakumar, who eventually comes across these women, decides to reunite the split couples.
Aby realises that he is in love with Sona, his childhood friend, but is unable to express his feelings. However, he faces a dilemma when he learns that her marriage has already been arranged.
A young politician has devious plans to advance his career. However, he suddenly develops a conscientious alter ego that interferes with his crooked efforts.

Premachandran, a carpenter, rescues Kanmani, an ill-treated maid, and takes her into his care. However, to escape from her former abusers, Kanmani dresses up as a boy and joins the team of carpenters.
Johnny pretends to be a gentleman but is a thief who thrives on lies and betrayals. His life turns upside down after his encounter with Adam, an orphan.

Unnikrishnan is forced to move to the city after he beats up some thugs for his foster family. In the city, he starts working for Ganapathy Iyer, a rich man who is seeking his long-lost lover.
Hareendran, a software tycoon, runs a successful company with his childhood friend. However, things take an unexpected turn when his friend damages his reputation.
Three inseparable friends devise an ingenious ploy to fund a destitute woman's marriage. However, destiny plays a cruel game after an unscrupulous individual steal their hard-earned funds.
Kasi and Suni decide to go on a road trip from Kerala to Nagaland in search of Kasi's girlfriend. On their way, they experience several life-defining moments.
An aspiring policeman embarks on an unauthorised mission to investigate a devious scientist. However, he confronts various challenges when his actions are exposed.
Ittymaani, who was raised in China, runs a business of counterfeit products in India. However, when he tries to help Annamma who is ignored by her sons, he lands in trouble because she falls ill.
Following a tycoon's discovery of a rare oil reserve, a compassionate beggar gets trapped in the dangerous mechanisms of his rapacious scheme.
A young woman with mystical abilities confronts personal struggles as evil emerges. However, to ensure the safety of the innocent, she must embrace her powers in an ever-changing world.

Gang leader Sakthivel adopts Amaran after a gang war, but years later, a survivor from an assassination attempt sparks doubt. Soon, Sakthivel suspects Amaran, igniting a conflict of loyalty and revenge.

Shivaramakrishnan is a government employee who struggles to make ends meet. In order to earn some quick money, he and his friends start a daycare centre, which proves to be even more disastrous.
While looking to borrow money to meet his wife's medical expenses, Durgaprasad uncovers a deadly terrorist plot and must act to save the city from destruction.

Sethunath is a successful writer who shares the story of his life with journalist Aneesa. He talks about falling in love with Priya and his inability to marry her because of his estranged wife, Manju.

Biju Poulose leaves his teaching job to pursue his dream of serving in the police force. Posted as the sub-inspector in Cochin, he has to handle notorious criminals who indulge in unlawful activities.
Dinesh, a conceited and wealthy young bachelor, goes to extreme lengths to impress a girl named Shobha with the help of his best friend Sagar, and Dinesh eventually hopes to marry Shobha.
Pooja Mathew, a spirited young girl, dreams about marrying only for love. Thus, she stops at nothing to impress Giri, who saved her once from a group of unruly men.
When his father asks him to manage their grocery store, Umesh runs away to Chennai to become a film-maker. His life changes after he takes a selfie with his old neighbour and posts it online.
While George's first love disappoints him, Malar, a college lecturer, restores his faith in love. His romantic journey takes him through several stages and helps him find his purpose.
Kichu is a heartless student leader who can go to any extent for power. He is asked to donate his blood to save a man named Krishnan, whose story changes him for the better.

Parthasarathy is well-loved by the people around him as he constantly works for their welfare. Soon, he falls in love with the daughter of his rival, unaware that she has an ulterior motive.
Seelabhati along with her mother visits a remote village where she starts working as a computer teacher. When some students mysteriously disappear, the villagers start blaming her educational course.

Four friends with a traumatic history reunite at a resort. All hell breaks loose when the group encounters unanticipated repercussions from their past.
Four people, a supermarket employee, a little girl, a housewife and a college student, deal with their everyday problems in life and try their best to overcome them.
A primary school teacher is obsessed with the world of cinema and dreams of becoming an actor one day. However, his blind obsession eventually leads him into a precarious situation.
Travelling from Mumbai to Pune in a four-wheeler, a motley crew of unlikely heroes must race against time to deliver a heart to a 13-year-old patient.
Jaison, a young tailor, gains superpowers after being struck by lightning. However, he must thwart the evil intentions of an unexpected adversary to become the superhero that his rural village needs.
Anna Wilfred loses her family at a young age when her father's personal manager deceives them. However, years later, she decides to take revenge on him.

Inspector General Durga Prasad gets appointed as the head of an anti-terrorism squad. However, a revelation soon forces him to choose between his family and his duty.
Aaron, an ardent cricket fan, decides to be positive even after losing his sight. When he gets the chance to realise his dream of entering the cricket team for the blind, he takes it.
Anwar, a Muslim boy, falls in love with a Hindu girl who rejects him and elopes with his best friend. Post her death, a misunderstanding leads the police to believe that he is a terrorist.
Narayankutty wishes to be a lawyer but ends up being a clerk in a government office. However, when he sees the law being breached or misused, he does not hesitate to raise his voice against it.
Vijay's life takes an unexpected turn when he falls for Merin. However, he is already betrothed to Pavithra, the daughter of an affluent man.

Three out of four brothers of a Malayali household are happily married while the fourth brother is engaged. When the beautiful Yamuna Rani becomes their new neighbour, she poses a threat to the wives.
Vinaychandran, a writer, makes a living by selling his average romantic stories. His life takes a turn when he is assumed to be an expert on matters of the heart while trying to help a professor.
When greed paves the way for betrayal, scheming and murder, a young tribal reluctantly dons the traditions of his ancestors to seek justice.
Malaikottai Vaaliban, an ageing warrior, returns to his village only to discover it has been overrun by colonisers. He challenges them to a fight, vowing to restore freedom.

Kunjunni, an orphan, and Radha, who makes a living by selling statues of deities, love each other. However, problems arise when her father opposes their relationship.
The lives of four friends Romario, Riyas, Yoodas and Athmaram, take a dramatic turn when a girl joins their mechanical engineering class.
Dr. Ruben Isaac takes up a position in a psychiatric hospital and uses humanitarian methods to treat his patients. However, things take a turn when his real identity is uncovered.
Baiju, a government worker, lives in Kumbalam, a rusty little village on the outskirts of Kochi and is beloved by the locals. He spends his free time coaching local boys in cricket.
Newly-weds Sreeja and Prasad struggle to cope with their lives and decide to sell Sreeja's gold chain for money. However, a thief steals the chain during a bus journey, adding to their woes.
Ajayan comes back to his village to be with his ailing mother. However, things get strange when a boy comes to his house claiming to be his son.
Vincent Kombana, a parish priest, is highly respected by the people of his village. However, things take an unusual turn after he witnesses a murder.
Porinju and Mariam, two lovers who share a complicated past, and Jose, their mutual friend, become involved in a life-changing village feud.
While SI Sebastian is known for his brilliant stature, his claims are put to the test after he misplaces a body. Trouble and chaos ensue when a woman alleges the dead man to be her husband.

When a powerful explosion occurs at the Vilayam beach seconds after Chief Minister Madhavan leaves the venue, Police Officer Rishikesh is tasked with the investigation to find the truth behind the blast.
Vimala and her three sisters run a theatre called Maharaja Talkies. They get in trouble when Pappachan, a rich man, forces Vimala to shut down the theatre.
When their flight is delayed, two cricketers, their friend and a photographer embark on a road trip to compete in the selection trials for a tournament. However, they face many challenges en route.
During the Mamangam fair, a new legend is born when a 12-year-old boy, Chandroth Valiya Panikkar, survives a battle with the mighty army of Zamorin.

The disastrous floods in Kerala in 2018 bring about fatal implications for every individual. Later, people from different backgrounds cooperate to weather the disaster.
Joji, an engineering dropout, dreams of becoming rich without his family's help. However, things take a turn after an unexpected event in the family.
When the disappearance of a policewoman's son threatens to ruin Vijay's family, he leaves no stone unturned in order to shield his family.

Prakashan, after drinking, encounters Vinod and a young woman near a carpenter's abode. Subsequently, both men, Prakashan and Venu, perceive this duo as an affectionate couple, suspecting the woman is Nirmala.
